description.en: Replaces the flat model list with a two-level picker: choose a provider first, then a model, then its reasoning effort. Selection is bound to the provider/model pair, and settings provide per-provider and per-model visibility toggles.
description.zh: 把模型选择器改为两级列表：先选厂商，再选模型，最后选推理等级，等级绑定到厂商与模型的组合；设置中提供按厂商和按模型隐藏的可见性开关。
